novelty_basis: F. W. Light's associativity test, presented in A. H. Clifford, G. B. Preston, The Algebraic Theory of Semigroups, Vol. 1 (AMS, 1961), section 1.2.
proof_check: written proof (proofs/paper/C17.md Theorem 1, four-line closure argument); 0 wrong verdicts in EXP-C17-01, skeptic-reviewed 2026-10-18 (reviews/skeptic_C07_C17_C20.md) (the Skeptic re-checked every generating set of every magma of order <= 3 and 236,381 generating sets of 20,000 random order-4 tables - 0 wrong verdicts)
statement: If S generates the finite magma M, then M is associative iff (x*s)*y = x*(s*y) for all x, y in M and s in S; the test costs 2n + 2n^2 probes per generator.
title: Light's test: generators suffice for associativity
